# Welcome to BixDot Discussions 👋

This is the place to:

- **Ask questions** — getting started, configuration, how things work
- **Share what you've built** — skills, integrations, workflows
- **Suggest features** — what would make BixDot more useful for you
- **Show & tell** — demos, screenshots, use cases

---

## Categories

**💬 General** — Questions, help, anything BixDot related

**💡 Ideas** — Feature requests and suggestions (not bugs — those go in Issues)

**🛠️ Show & Tell** — Share what you've built with BixDot

**📢 Announcements** — Updates from the BixDot team (DigiTech Business)

---

## Ground Rules

- Be respectful — we have a [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- Search before posting — your question may already be answered
- Security issues go to security@bixdot.app — never here
- No spam, no self-promotion unrelated to BixDot
